line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_toy_slot_min_magnitude: Minimum magnitude for the toys power.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_toy_slot_min_scale: Minimum scaling. When the selected scaling is below this value the minimum magnitude will be used. When it is above the magnitude will scale up to the max magnitude.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_toy_slot_scaling_type: Changes how the toys power is calculated. If individual is selected for "all" you can define it per toy/slot.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_toy_slot_synchronization_: Changes which actor in the scene the toy is synchronized with. If individual is selected for "all" you can define it per toy/slot.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_undress_if_need: Actors will get fully undressed as soon as a sexual animation plays.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_undress_wigs: Also undress wigs of actors. A wig is anything that uses slot 31 and contains the "Hair Tint" shader type. So any head gear that has at least one part colored in the actors hair color. This also includes helmets which have just a little hair part beneath.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_undressing_about: Select which armor slots are stripped by OStim. See this if you don't know what that is: https://www.creationkit.com/index.php?title=Biped_Object\nThese settings apply to both the Player AND NPCs. Mouse over the names to see if you are wearing an armor piece in that slot. Green names are what Bethesda designated the slots for. Cyan names are what the community designated the slots for. Take the names with a grain of salt as many mods don't use the proper slots.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_unequip_strap_on_if_not_n: Automatically remove strap-ons from female actors when they stop performing penetrative actions.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_unrestricted_navigation: If checked all requirement checks for all animations are skipped and you can play any animation with any combination of actors.\nNote: This can lead to some unexpected results in auto mode.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_update: Try to flush out old scripts.\nMay not be reliable, perform a clean install if you get weird behavior after updating.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_use_auto_mode_always: If enabled, scenes will play out on their own without user input via procedural generation.\nNote: If you have only used Manual mode briefly or not at all, and never became adept with using it, I STRONGLY recommend you give manual mode a fair chance before using this.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_use_auto_mode_dominant: Always starts scenes where the player plays a dominant role in automatic mode.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_use_auto_mode_fades: Fade to black in between animation changes. Will only fade if the new animation is further away then the navigation distance.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_use_auto_mode_solo: Always starts solo scenes in automatic mode.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_use_auto_mode_submissive: Always starts scenes where the player plays a submissive role in automatic mode.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_use_auto_mode_vanilla: Always starts scenes with no dominant/submissive roles in automatic mode.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_use_intro_scenes: Use designated intro scenes when no specific scene was given. If disabled, any idle may be chosen.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_use_sos_sex: Assign gender based on SoS faction. If disabled OStim will not recognize futanari actors as having a schlong.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_tooltip_use_tng_sex: Assing gender based on TNG formlists. If disabled OStim will not recognize futanari actors as having a schlong.
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_use_auto_mode_dominant: Use auto mode if player dominant
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_use_auto_mode_fades: Fade out in between animation transitions
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_use_auto_mode_solo: Use auto mode in solo scenes
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_use_auto_mode_submissive: Use auto mode if player is submissive
line:mcm_flick_translation/ostim:OStim_E.$ostim_use_auto_mode_vanilla: Use auto mode in vanilla scenes
